_comment: Reference template for Kiro plugin-tier ponytail. Copy the 'hooks' array into a hook file under .kiro/hooks/ponytail.json (project) or ~/.kiro/hooks/ponytail.json (global). Replace PONYTAIL_DIR with the path to your ponytail checkout (e.g. ~/.kiro/plugins/ponytail). Kiro forwards each command hook's stdout as injected context for SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, and PreToolUse; the --host=kiro flag routes the shared scripts to Kiro's raw-stdout output and its own ~/.kiro state dir. node must be on PATH. The always-on ruleset still works without these hooks via .kiro/steering/ponytail.md; the hooks add /ponytail level switching and subagent injection.
